prerequisites: See valid SPO Part A and Part B MECB

learning_outcomes.text: Students demonstrate that they master the fundamental methodologies of an engineering task; this is tested, among other things, by questions regarding the Bachelor's thesis and general technical questions.

syllabus_topics: Presentation of the results of an engineering activity (Bachelor's Thesis)
Defense of the engineering activity, its results, and the chosen engineering approach/methodology based on the knowledge acquired throughout the Mechatronics study program
assessment_rules: Students' knowledge is graded based on a 20-minute presentation followed by a 40-minute oral examination.
institution: Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft — Mechatronik (B.Eng.)
